verdict.rationale: Tilled is an API-first payments platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent spec download. The evidence covers only API keys, webhooks, a dev portal on a custom domain and named APIs like DisputesAPI, none of which shows a spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
